exposed_new_medical_sources.rationale: B5_dental_room carries every dental owner: reclined chair, lamp above, separate tray, handpiece and mirror. It is a coherent unqualified optional cue, but adds a different treatment context and small tools rather than clarifying withheld records. No dental part is retained.

B3_two_door_boundary compares the complete glazed-room-door→anteroom→second-door→corridor chain. It is not interchangeable with a lone glazed counter or lone exit. Extra architecture dilutes the record relation, and no pressure/infection/confinement motive can be inferred. No two-door cue retained.

B4_pathology_annex realizes microscope, laboratory bench, labeled glass-slide rack and a separate specimen container with all placements. This unqualified full cue is coherent but changes the visible custody question toward specimen handling and competes with the chart. No bench/specimen source effect retained.

B4_pathology_annex realizes the external flask identifier and separate screen with the microscope image confined inside its bezel. That complete unqualified proxy cannot establish immortality, HeLa, identity or consent. It creates a second pictorial owner and a new laboratory thread; none retained.

E12 requires adult context and a tight forearm-only frame excluding face and remaining body. Adult age is not frozen, and the forearm-only view prevents assessment of the chosen face/hair reference scope and the record/door relationship. No cropped-body source cue is used.

E04 requires adult context plus a large foreground medical-image display occluding a separate patient. No adult fact is frozen. Its deliberate occlusion would hide the reference face and failed handover endpoints; no display/occlusion cue is retained.

E01 requires an adult lying behind a raised bed rail, outstretched hand and wall-hook call handset beyond reach. Adult age, bed state, rail and handset are absent. Replacing them with a counter/glass/file would strip the source's distinctive owners, so this whole cue is not adopted or relabeled.

boundary: No claim that newly integrated data caused the final scene. Topic fidelity and independent scene pixels will be evaluated separately.
